name: TtsClient
description: FreeInk cloud text-to-speech bridge: sends page text to a caller-supplied, provider-agnostic HTTP request builder over SecureHttpClient and delivers the synthesized audio bytes to a sink for AudioManager to play. Ships no vendor integration — the request shape (endpoint, auth, body) is the caller's chosen TTS provider's, not this SDK's concern. Header-only.
keywords: tts, text-to-speech, audio, https, network, accessibility
notes: Requires SecureNet (SecureHttpClient.h) in the consuming project's lib_deps, and -DFREEINK_NET_WOLFSSL=1 plus a wolfSSL lib_dep for https endpoints — see SecureNet's own library.json notes.
